authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: User accepts the cereal-family match despite rice/barley versus millet semantics. Preserve the survey gloss and flag cereal identification or semantic extension as unresolved. Earlier audit: Homepage discovery points to CDIAL 3515 kōdrava. Full article gives Gujarati kodrī grain separated from chaff in the Paspalum scrobiculatum millet family, alongside kodrā and Prakrit kud-. The survey gloss rice is not independently supported by this article. Hold the proposed family for checking cereal identification or regional semantic extension; do not silently change the survey gloss or treat a rice/millet mismatch as merely uncertain cross-IA transmission. This previous hold is resolved by explicit user editorial choice on 2026-09-15; its evidential qualifications remain.
